title: oblien/openship
claim: oblien/openship — A self-hosted deployment platform for shipping apps and AI agents to infrastructure you control.
hook: Self-hosted Vercel with a twist: deploy from a desktop app that drives your servers over SSH — no always-on box to harden.
why_good: Point it at a repo and it builds, ships, routes and TLS-terminates your app; drive it from a desktop app, web dashboard or CLI (openship init && openship deploy). Self-host the full stack (Postgres/Redis/API/dashboard + an OpenResty edge with auto domains and Let's Encrypt) with one openship up, or deploy out to remote servers over SSH.
value: Buyer: indie devs and small teams tired of Vercel/Render bills; agencies hosting many client apps. Money: managed cloud + team tier on the open core (the Coolify playbook). The desktop on-ramp is the real acquisition wedge.
risk: Why not a pick: self-hosted PaaS is crowded (Coolify, Dokploy, Kamal, Render) and big clouds keep absorbing the feature. Watch whether the desktop/no-server mode converts hobbyists faster than Coolify — if not, it's one more entrant in a red ocean.

zh.claim: oblien/openship —— 自托管的部署平台,把应用和 AI agent 发布到你自己掌控的基础设施上。
zh.hook: 有点不一样的自托管 Vercel:用一个桌面 app 通过 SSH 部署你的服务器——没有需要长期加固的常驻机器。
zh.why_good: 把它指向一个 repo,它就帮你构建、发布、路由并做 TLS 终止;可用桌面 app、网页面板或 CLI 驱动(openship init && openship deploy)。一条 openship up 自托管整套栈(Postgres/Redis/API/面板 + OpenResty 边缘,自动域名 + Let's Encrypt),或通过 SSH 部署到远端服务器。
zh.value: 买家:被 Vercel/Render 账单劝退的独立开发者和小团队;要托管大量客户应用的代理商。变现:开源内核 + 托管云 + 团队版(Coolify 的打法)。桌面入口是真正的获客楔子。
zh.risk: 为什么没进精选:自托管 PaaS 已很挤(Coolify、Dokploy、Kamal、Render),而且是大厂不断吸收的功能。看点:桌面/免服务器模式能否比 Coolify 更快转化玩家——不能的话,它只是红海里又一个入场者。
zh.does: 把它指向一个 repo,它就帮你构建、发布、路由并做 TLS 终止;可用桌面 app、网页面板或 CLI 驱动(openship init && openship deploy)。一条 openship up 自托管整套栈(Postgres/Redis/API/面板 + OpenResty 边缘,自动域名 + Let's Encrypt),或通过 SSH 部署到远端服务器。
zh.edge: 最亮的一手是『桌面控制面』:只在 app 打开时运行、通过 SSH 驱动你的服务器——没有需要长期加固的常驻机器,也没有公网暴露面。Coolify、Dokploy 得先立一台服务器并加固;openship 让个人开发者直接从笔记本部署,等真要 push-to-deploy 时再升级到常驻服务器。
zh.why_use: 自己拥有 PaaS,省掉按席位、按用量的云账单——还带一个 Coolify 没有的『个人友好入口』(桌面版、免服务器)。想在自己机器上要 Vercel 式部署、又不想天天盯基础设施的人很合适。

does: Point it at a repo and it builds, ships, routes and TLS-terminates your app; drive it from a desktop app, web dashboard or CLI (openship init && openship deploy). Self-host the full stack (Postgres/Redis/API/dashboard + an OpenResty edge with auto domains and Let's Encrypt) with one openship up, or deploy out to remote servers over SSH.
edge: The standout is a desktop control plane that runs only while the app is open and drives your servers over SSH — no always-on box to secure, no public surface. Coolify and Dokploy make you stand up and harden a server first; openship lets a solo dev deploy from a laptop, then graduate to an always-on server only for push-to-deploy.
why_use: Own your PaaS and skip the per-seat, per-usage cloud bill — with a solo-friendly on-ramp (desktop, no server) that Coolify doesn't have. A fit if you want Vercel-style deploys on your own boxes without babysitting infra.
